title: GlossaryGo Glossary
description: The local glossary format accepted by GlossaryGo.
$comment: Runtime-only source constraints: the glossary must be a readable UTF-8 .yaml file no larger than 5 MiB and contain exactly one YAML document. YAML directives, custom tags, anchors, aliases, and merge keys are unsupported.

terms.$comment: Same-name entries, including identical term-and-definition pairs, are independent and permitted. Only the two string fields are stored.
